description: Sets the addressed clip's gain - linear by default, dB with db=true - on every destination channel, or one channel. The address (at or region) must match exactly one clip.

at.description: Timeline position of the clip (exclusive with region)

gain.description: Gain value (linear unless db=true; linear must be >= 0)

project.description: Path to the .audium project package (absolute paths recommended)

unit.description: Unit for positions (default bars; bars/beats are 1-based, seconds/clocks absolute)

name: clip_gain
title: Set clip gain
